newsitem.title: USA: Nine West sets manufacturing restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Nine West sets manufacturing restructuring.

text.p: Nine West Group Inc said it will close three manufacturing facilities and reconfigure operations at two other facilities in a restructuring of its North American manufacturing operations.
About 1,000 jobs will be affected by the moves, it said.
The company said plants in Madison and Crothersville, Ind., and Flemingsburg, Ky., will be closed beginning in April and continuing through the end of the year.
It said operations will be reconfigured at two plants in Vanceburg, Ky., during the same time period.

In connection with these actions, Nine West said, it will relocate its Cincinnati raw materials warehouse, central support operations, and Harrison, Ohio, product development center to a new facility in Hebron, Ky.
The company said it will fulfill production needs by utilizing its existing cost competitive worldwide production capabilities. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
